    ['python', '-c', '''
import markdown
from markdown.extensions.toc import render_inner_html, run_postprocessors, striptags

from markdown.extensions.toc import slugify

md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=["toc"])
md_text = r"# escaped\\_character"

print("Input:", repr(md_text))
print("Input chars:", [ord(c) for c in md_text])

# Convert but don't run toc yet
# Actually, toc runs during convert. Let me check the tree before toc runs.

# Parse without toc
md2 = markdown.Markdown(extensions=[])
html2 = md2.convert(md_text)
print("\\nWithout toc:")
print("HTML:", html2)

for el in md2.parser.root.iter():
    if el.tag == 'h1':
        print(f"el.text: {repr(el.text)}")
        print(f"el.text chars: {[ord(c) for c in el.text]}")
        break
'''],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='.'
)
print("STDOUT:", result.stdout)
if result.stderr:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr[-200:])
